summary: NexGel, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into Amendment No. 1 to its Asset Purchase and Exclusive License Agreement with Celularity Inc., acquiring Celularity's commercial-stage regenerative biomaterials portfolio. Total consideration is $13.3 million: an $8.3 million upfront cash payment and a $5 million convertible promissory note with a conversion price of $0.60 per share, 10% interest, and 18-month maturity. The note ranks pari passu with other notes from a concurrent private placement. The board has not disclosed a recommendation or financial advisor. The transaction commenced on April 17, 2026. Watch for integration progress, note conversion terms, and potential dilution from the convertible note.
